why: A (universe 0) is the conjunction of seven theorems about the project's category SEPLoc: localizationPrefunctor_map_id, homMk_comp, id_eq, homMk_eq_homMk_iff ([D] = [D'] iff common refinement, i.e. the transitivity of Equiv), homMk_surjective, localizationFunctor_toPrefunctor and isInvertedBy_localizationFunctor. B says the objects of SEP(F⁻¹) are the strong bundles (SEPLoc.toSEP bijective), the hom-types are GenSBMap A A' (a type equality, rfl), and the class of a diagram W ←1 W →1 W is the identity. A_to_B: (1), (2) hold by the definitions (one-field structure, rfl); (3) is A's id_eq after subst of the middle and of the two legs (HEq → Eq). B_to_A: id_eq comes from B (3); homMk_comp, localizationPrefunctor_map_id and localizationFunctor_toPrefunctor are rfl; homMk_eq_homMk_iff, homMk_surjective and isInvertedBy_localizationFunctor are not consequences of B (B has no composition, which its author left unformalized) and are re-proved outright from non-item lemmas (SDiagram.cls_eq_cls_iff, cls_surjective, and the explicit inverse [ofHom Ψ].symm via equiv_comp_symm / equiv_symm_comp, avoiding SEPLoc.theorem_10_3_10, whose proof uses the banned homMk_eq_homMk_iff). On what B formalizes (objects, morphisms, identities) the project's definitions are exactly the text's; A additionally carries the composition and the localization functor.
B_issue: Not a problem in B: it does not formalize the composition (its author had no independent composite diagram of strong bundles), so B only pins down objects, morphisms and identities; the category laws in B come from the project's instance SEPLoc.category, through 𝟙.
overlap: HARNESS: the statements of isInvertedBy_localizationFunctor and localizationFunctor_toPrefunctor mention the definition localizationFunctor, whose map_comp proof field (localizationFunctor._proof_2) is proved with the banned homMk_eq_homMk_iff. So plain #rt_check fails on both directions for that name only (recorded with #guard_msgs); #rt_check_soft passes on both, reporting it reached only through the proof fields of localizationFunctor. rt_overlap B_to_A: 1307 shared project theorems, essentially all structural: the proof fields of SEPLoc.category and localizationFunctor in the statements (equiv_id_comp, equiv_comp_id, equiv_assoc, IsRefinement.comp, the strong bundle weak fibred product, pull-back and unit-section machinery, the sc-calculus beneath). The lemmas the proof itself reuses are cls_surjective, cls_eq_cls_iff, cls_eq_cls_of_equiv, equiv_comp_symm and equiv_symm_comp, the same ones the project's proofs use.
